blind_audit.rationale: AIRE promotes expression of tissue-restricted self antigens in medullary thymic epithelial cells. This broad self-antigen display exposes developing thymocytes to peripheral self proteins and supports deletion of strongly self-reactive clones. Loss of AIRE therefore disrupts central tolerance and permits multiorgan autoimmunity.

nearest_material_review.tested_construct: CIITA and the RFX complex are transcriptional regulators required for MHC class II gene expression. Loss of CIITA can abolish MHC II expression on antigen-presenting cells, impairing positive selection and peripheral activation of CD4-positive T cells and causing combined immunodeficiency.
nearest_material_review.resolution: Nearest immune item tests CIITA/MHC-II transcription and CD4 selection; this item tests AIRE-dependent tissue-restricted self-antigen display and central negative selection.
